mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 5.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to increased policy tightening expectations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not cross above 5.5% as predicted, or 20-day returns are not negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL index signal aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously
failure_condition: The proxies FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL do not move in tandem, or 20-day returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate sustained labor market strength.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains ≥4.0% or 5-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the INDPRO index of production signals robust supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained monthly increase, or 60-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in quarterly GDP demand (GDPC1) and monthly demand units (HOUST) indicate strong economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rise simultaneously
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST do not both rise simultaneously, or 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), sustained increases in the federal funds rate lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher interest rate expectations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not rise in the tightening cycle, or 60-day returns are not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with falling unemployment rates (UNRATE), positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days are anticipated as markets expect further labor market gains.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% in late-cycle expansion, or 5-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
